description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource for bulk import operations in the Fineract platform. It provides endpoints to retrieve import documents, get output template locations, and download output templates, primarily related to bulk data import functionality.

classes.name: BulkImportApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class handling bulk import related API endpoints, secured by permission checks, facilitating data retrieval, template location fetching, and template download for bulk import processes.

methods.name: retrieveImportDocuments
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve import data based on entity type, with validation and filtering.

methods.name: retriveOutputTemplateLocation
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch the location of an output template document identified by importDocumentId.

methods.name: getOutputTemplate
methods.description: Handles GET requests to download the output template as an Excel file, identified by importDocumentId.
